name: Build And Breach CQB
summary:
BUILD & BREACH CQB is a mixed-reality close-quarters battle (CQB) simulator that lets you design and clear tactical environments inside your real-world space.

Using passthrough mixed reality, you can place walls, doors, furniture, and obstacles directly into your physical environment to create custom CQB layouts.
